canonical_order_schema_detail.classification: canonical admission request and immutable event aggregate; no standalone caller-constructible canonical Order DTO

fingerprints.command: operation_type plus every normalized closed request field except correlation_id; command_id, idempotency_key and causation_id are included
fingerprints.event: SHA-256 over canonical NFC/UTF-8 JSON of the complete immutable event envelope except event_fingerprint_sha256
fingerprints.domain_or_helper: frozen contract canonical JSON rules; executable oracle exists only in tests/architecture/test_cryptohunter_commands_events_order_lifecycle_and_idempotency.py

other_order_types.execution_adapter: bot_core.exchanges.base.OrderRequest and OrderResult are transport DTOs
other_order_types.database_legacy_dto: bot_core.database.manager.Order and OrderIn are mutable persistence DTOs
other_order_types.paper_projection: bot_core.execution.paper.LedgerEntry and generated paper-* order IDs are simulator records
other_order_types.routing_projection: bot_core.execution.intent_store.IntentStore stores replaceable routing bindings, not accepted Order membership
other_order_types.test_fixture_or_oracle: tests/architecture/test_cryptohunter_commands_events_order_lifecycle_and_idempotency.py is executable contract coverage, not production authority

canonical_order_lifecycle_detail.reopen_legality: forbidden: terminal states have no outgoing transitions; identical late facts are replay and other late facts require reconciliation/audit without regression
canonical_order_lifecycle_detail.cancel_semantics: request is legal only from ACKNOWLEDGED or PARTIALLY_FILLED; confirmation terminates as CANCELLED; rejection restores the exact stored pre-request state, never a caller target
canonical_order_lifecycle_detail.reject_semantics: venue rejection is legal only from SUBMISSION_PENDING or RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and terminates as REJECTED
canonical_order_lifecycle_detail.partial_fill_semantics: legal in pending, acknowledged, partially-filled, cancel/replace-pending and reconciliation states; cumulative must be greater than zero and below quantity
canonical_order_lifecycle_detail.replace_semantics: request is legal only from ACKNOWLEDGED or PARTIALLY_FILLED; confirmation terminates original as REPLACED and binds a distinct preallocated replacement_order_id; rejection restores stored pre-request state

durability.head: NOT_FOUND
durability.production_test_separation: oracle is test-only; production implementation absent

self_mint_scope: non-authoritative runtime and persistence paths only; self-minted data does not become a genuine canonical Core-accepted Order fact
self_mint_exploit_paths: DatabaseManager.record_order accepts caller OrderIn/dict, including status, exchange_order_id, client_order_id and numeric fields, and inserts or mutates an Order row without canonical Core admission
DatabaseManager.update_order_status accepts caller-selected status and exchange_order_id and directly mutates the row
IntentStore.save_order_binding uses INSERT OR REPLACE for caller-selected order_id, exchange, symbol, client_order_id and created_at
PaperTradingExecutionService mints paper-<counter> IDs and mutable filled/cancelled LedgerEntry observations without canonical ord UUIDv7 identity or accepted lifecycle history
adapter OrderResult and runtime status paths carry venue/caller observations without authenticated adapter membership bound to a Core acceptance record

order_identity.order_id: ord_<lowercase canonical UUIDv7>; distinct from command_id
order_identity.instrument_binding: instrument_id; Full Fill additionally exact-binds instrument_metadata_version through M0.5 historical resolution
order_identity.market_type_binding: not an Order field in M0.7; inherited/verified through exact M0.5 account/instrument authority
order_identity.strategy_binding: strategy_instance_id is required only when source_type is STRATEGY_INSTANCE; null for OPERATOR and SYSTEM_RECONCILIATION

order_instrument_dependency: M0.5 exact current authority at command admission and exact historical Instrument resolution for Full Fill; production M0.5 is NOT_AVAILABLE
order_account_dependency: M0.5 exact accepted ExchangeAccount projection bound to workspace_id, exchange_id, environment and market/capability policy; production authority NOT_FOUND

additional_rules: Fill side must agree with the immutable accepted Order plan
Fill instrument_metadata_version must exact-resolve a trusted historical Instrument
Fill venue_trade_id must equal the lifecycle event safe payload
Fill identity/fingerprint and complete accepted Fill history must validate before lifecycle mutation

fill_lifecycle_legality.filled_order: identical accepted fact is replay; any other fact requires reconciliation/audit and cannot regress or mutate terminal state

quantity_accounting.owner: M0.7 lifecycle progression over trusted accepted Full Fill facts; M0.8 consumes the accepted economic facts for accounting
quantity_accounting.ordered_quantity: immutable positive exact decimal quantity from accepted SUBMIT_ORDER/ORDER_PLANNED
quantity_accounting.cumulative_filled_quantity: sum of unique accepted full-economic Fill facts in deterministic accepted event sequence
quantity_accounting.remaining_quantity: order quantity minus cumulative executed quantity
quantity_accounting.filled_equality: FILLED iff cumulative equals order quantity
quantity_accounting.partial_equality: PARTIALLY_FILLED iff cumulative is greater than zero and less than order quantity
quantity_accounting.duplicate_fill: identical durable or scoped external replay has zero new economic effect; conflicts require reconciliation

duplicate_replay_semantics.same_command_or_order_submission_same_fi: return byte-equivalent immutable recorded outcome as COMMAND_REPLAYED; no new transition or side effect
duplicate_replay_semantics.same_command_or_order_submission_conflic: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; no mutation or side effect
duplicate_replay_semantics.same_exchange_acknowledgement: deduplicate venue_order_id plus acknowledgement fact; identical replay ignored
duplicate_replay_semantics.same_exchange_order_id_other_core_order: no explicit standalone rule; scope/history conflict must fail closed and reconcile
duplicate_replay_semantics.same_fill_or_external_trade: identical replay ignored; different economics is FILL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT

adapter_authenticity: Production adapter results are transport observations. The frozen contract requires EXECUTION_ADAPTER-owned facts and trusted context, but no production authenticated adapter-membership-to-Order admission boundary was found. Content fingerprint is not admission proof.

concurrency.rule: strict per-order aggregate_version linearizes accepted facts; stale, gaps and impossible transitions fail closed
concurrency.ack_vs_cancel: cancel request cannot precede ACKNOWLEDGED; after ACK, strict next version determines order
concurrency.fill_vs_cancel: fill remains legal in CANCEL_PENDING; whichever accepted next version is first determines progression, and terminal cancellation forbids a new fill mutation
concurrency.fill_vs_reject: both may originate at SUBMISSION_PENDING but terminal REJECTED forbids later fill mutation; strict next version linearizes the winner
concurrency.two_fills: strict consecutive versions plus fill/external-trade dedupe; recompute cumulative from complete accepted history
concurrency.replace_vs_fill: fill remains legal in REPLACE_PENDING; terminal REPLACED forbids later fill mutation
concurrency.duplicate_exchange_event: same event identity/fingerprint or same acknowledgement fact is replay; conflicts fail closed

test_discovery.tests/architecture/test_cryptohunter_com: full frozen M0.7 JSON/Markdown parity, closed command/event schemas, lifecycle, replay, Fill binding, quantity and reference-model oracle
test_discovery.tests/architecture/test_m07_accepted_ful: production boundary: only structural Fill validation exists; no self-enrolling Instrument/Fill/Order lifecycle authority
test_discovery.tests/architecture/test_cryptohunter_exc: M0.5 account/instrument/catalog contract and exact historical resolution oracle
test_discovery.tests/execution/test_exchange_lifecycle_: runtime execution lifecycle behavior, not canonical M0.7 authority
test_discovery.tests/services/test_order_router.py: legacy service routing behavior, not canonical admission
